brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.requirement: Seven-cell honeycomb work surface (central cell with 6 neighbors)
requirements.evidence: 7 pieces placed: piece:0,0,0;full (center) + piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:-1,1,0;full, piece:0,-1,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,-1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full forming contiguous honeycomb at level 0
7 top covers installed, one per cell: cover:-1,0,0;full;top, cover:-1,1,0;full;top, cover:0,-1,0;full;top, cover:0,0,0;full;top, cover:0,1,0;full;top, cover:1,-1,0;full;top, cover:1,0,0;full;top

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 perimeter caps placed covering all 18 exposed edges (42 total edges - 12 shared internal edges x2 = 18): 3 caps on each outer cell at bearings 90/150/210 etc. e.g. cap:-1,0,0;*;90/150/210 etc.; check_build meshClash=clear, ok=true

finish.summary: Built 7-cell honeycomb (center + 6 around) with full top covers on all cells and 18 caps sealing the entire perimeter. Build verified: ok=true, meshClash=clear (only LOOSE_BODY warning about joint bolts, not an error).
